g.text: J++ part, pointer and identity outside J++ stop most 9B and 27B lookups, not Muse's
Sanity swap. Lookups still switching (%), out of the whole change's switches. The line from
grey to purple is what the part removes beyond a random part (same size): its extra loss.
Wrong pair: mean differences of other item pairs, on the scenes where it reached at least
0.9 of identity outside J++'s share. In the routes test, identity outside J++ cuts identity
answers only 0.08 / 0.14 / 0.05 more than the wrong pair (9B / 27B / Muse; the bar fixed in advance: 0.15).
° gate lowered to 0.75 after the data
